title: A Bathhouse Finds a Second Income
paras: In the hill town of Darava, visitors usually come to see a merchant’s painted [[tomb|tomb]]. Yet a narrow lane behind the monument leads to another attraction: a nineteenth-century bathhouse where travellers can still [[bathe|bathe]] in deep stone tubs. Its tiled courtyard now provides a [[setting|setting]] for small evening concerts, helping an old business survive.

For years, the bathhouse faced a [[downward|downward]] trend in earnings as families installed bathrooms at home. Closure seemed the most [[probable|probable]] outcome until its manager, Leila, signed a [[contract|contract]] with a local music association. The agreement gave musicians use of the courtyard twice a week, while reserving the bathing rooms for their original purpose.

Arriving before the first concert, I watched an assistant carry a [[bundle|bundle]] of freshly washed robes upstairs. Made from thick [[flannel|flannel]], they kept guests warm after their baths. Below, three musicians began their [[rehearsal|rehearsal]], testing how softly they could play beneath the stone arches. Leila explained that the building also hosted [[civil|civil]] wedding ceremonies, although these were held only when the baths were closed.

The new income pays for roof repairs and supports two laundry jobs. It has also changed how visitors spend their time: instead of leaving after a quick photograph, many stay for tea and music. As the final notes faded that evening, a guest emerged from the bathing rooms in a warm robe. Here, preserving history meant keeping it useful.
zh: 在山城达拉瓦，游客通常是为了一座商人的彩绘陵墓而来。然而，纪念建筑后方的一条窄巷通向另一处景点：一座十九世纪的浴场，旅客至今仍能在深深的石砌浴池中洗澡。如今，铺着瓷砖的庭院成了小型晚间音乐会的场地，帮助这家老店维持经营。
多年来，随着当地家庭在家中安装浴室，浴场的收入持续下降。停业似乎是最可能的结局，直到经理莱拉与当地一个音乐协会签订了合同。协议允许乐手每周两次使用庭院，同时保留浴室原有的用途。
第一场音乐会开始前，我来到浴场，看见一名助手把一捆刚洗好的浴袍抱上楼。这些浴袍用厚法兰绒制成，能让客人洗浴后保持温暖。楼下，三位乐手开始排练，试着在石拱下尽可能轻柔地演奏。莱拉解释说，这栋建筑还承办非宗教婚礼仪式，不过只在浴场不营业时举行。
新增收入用于修缮屋顶，还维持了两个洗衣岗位。这也改变了游客安排时间的方式：许多人不再匆匆拍照后离去，而是留下来喝茶、听音乐。那天晚上，最后几个音符渐渐消散时，一位客人穿着暖和的浴袍从浴室走了出来。在这里，保护历史意味着让它继续发挥作用。

q.s: The bathhouse's earnings rose during the years when local families were installing bathrooms at home.
q.why: 第二段说明这段时期浴场收入呈下降趋势。

q.s: Wedding ceremonies are held only when the baths are closed.
q.why: 第三段明确说明婚礼只在浴场关闭时举行。

q.s: The laundry workers earn more than the musicians who perform at the bathhouse.
q.why: 文章未比较洗衣工与乐手的收入。
